questions.stem: How is auxin used commercially as a rooting powder?

options.text: It is sprayed on leaves to make them grow faster
It is applied to the cut end of plant cuttings to stimulate root growth
It is added to soil to kill weeds
It is used to prevent fruit from ripening too quickly

questions.explanation: Auxin-based rooting powder is applied to the cut end of plant cuttings to stimulate rapid root development. This allows gardeners and farmers to clone plants more effectively from cuttings.
